analysis.reasonEn: Previous 3 sessions held a wait-and-see stance. Today, RSI at 53.5 confirms neutral zone, MACD histogram shows continued improvement. However, ADX at 18.8 indicates a non-trending phase, and the volume ratio of 1.10 over 5 days shows minimal increase relative to volatility. Price is in a Higher Low recovery phase, with the 5-day low at 246,500 vs. the 20-day low at 189,200. Current position at 66.3% of 52-week range. Price above 50% Fibonacci retracement level of 247,250. Current price of 271,000 is above SMA5 (265,900) and SMA20 (245,650) but below SMA50 (282,284). Weekly ADX at 40.4 confirms a strong trend, but daily ADX at 18.8 suggests no established trend. 4H RSI at 54.5 aligns with daily. Multi-timeframe alignment confirmed. 3 out of 5 confluence checklist items met. Support at 240,000, resistance at 370,000.
